subject: Adaptive dependency-aware live fusion and stronger cross-worker networking

clayresearch.delta: Add adaptive live-fusion as a cross-cutting research candidate: provenance-bound deltas, current dependency routing, causal predecessor checks, anti-entropy repair and cost-aware targeted/dense/digest modes. Preserve the rule that networking does not increase evidence strength.
clayresearch.next_test: Adjudicate real-repo replay and compare whether adaptive routing is Pareto-better than simpler broadcast/tag-only under correctness, stale-risk and resource shadows.

frank.delta: Frank-related research deltas should reach all and only current affected work where possible, but high-impact contradictions must propagate through transitive dependencies even when vocabulary similarity is low. This changes research coordination only; Frank gains no self-Harness authority.
frank.next_test: Replay a Frank loop/reward premise invalidation and verify affected Harness/GWT/ClayGraph/UnifiedDB work is interrupted before next material effect.

gwt.delta: Treat worker-delta delivery like GWT causal observability: delivered != reconstructed != used != local effect. FusionReceipt should expose these stages rather than equating network exposure with causal uptake.
gwt.next_test: Measure receiver reconstruction/use closure for routed deltas and shuffled/irrelevant controls.

emergenz.delta: Increased mesh coupling is not emergence evidence. Stronger live fusion must be lesionable and tested for overcoupling, synchrony collapse, stale-cascade amplification and false interruption.
emergenz.next_test: Ablate causal dependency edges and anti-entropy separately; compare information transfer and failure amplification without interpreting connectivity as consciousness.

claycode.delta: BASE semantics should eventually prove they can express KnowledgeDeltaV2, BranchDependencyIndex, RoutePlan, AntiEntropyDigest and FusionReceipt without reopening semantics unless compilation exposes a concrete gap.
claycode.next_test: After parser/IR packages exist, compile minimal live-fusion records/rules through parser -> canonical IR -> type/effect -> evaluator; no BASE PASS credit from representability alone.

hyperposition.delta: Preserve alternative route plans TARGETED_DELTA/DENSE_FANOUT/DIGEST_ONLY and uncertainty over dependency completeness; do not collapse to one routing policy before cost/recall evidence.
hyperposition.next_test: Stress ambiguous dependency spans where targeted and dense modes have similar expected cost and verify bounded reversible route switching.

claygraph.delta: ClayGraph becomes the derived dependency-routing surface for live fusion, but missing/stale edges must be observable via projection hashes and anti-entropy; graph activation remains non-authoritative.
claygraph.next_test: Inject missing/stale edges and measure relevant-branch recall, false positives, repair latency and projection rebuild correctness.

unifieddb.delta: UnifiedDB should persist canonical KnowledgeDelta identities, causal predecessors, semantic epochs, per-branch ack/repair state and FusionReceipts; physical monolithic storage is not required.
unifieddb.next_test: Materialize delta/ack/repair state transactionally and replay out-of-order/duplicate events across crash/restart without mixed epochs.

harness.delta: Harness should execute the real-repo matched replay/fault matrix and treat routed-data exposure as non-evidence until receiver use/effect and verified outcomes are observed.
harness.next_test: Run broadcast vs tag-only vs adaptive v0.2 on current work/branch events with missing-edge, stale-epoch, duplicate, causal-reorder and restart faults; record exact resource/latency/recovery rows.

global_controls: dependency graph may be incomplete or stale
anti-entropy repair is mandatory for silent-gap resistance
dense fanout remains valid when dependency span is global or cost model favors it
candidate remains rollbackable and unpromoted until real replay/recovery evidence
Frank remains separate research subject and never mutates Clay

out_of_box_experiment.name: high_centrality_premise_inversion
out_of_box_experiment.result: tag-only recall 1/9; dependency-aware candidate and broadcast each reached 9/9 affected branches
out_of_box_experiment.interpretation: high-centrality contradiction is a case where stronger networking should intentionally become dense
